widgets_values:
NEW independent template; no old graph or Core sampling math changes.
Use a legal CFR video longer than6.2s, with real stereo source audio. Local test media are NOT distributed.
Native Video Slice selects0-6.2s before resident decode; SourceClock observes actual PTS. Conform maps source origin1s to124 frames at24fps; LTX trims to121.
Final trim delivers120frames /5s at256x448. Full LTX VAE encodes half-canvas RGB; existing x2 latent lift then three independent Identity updates.
This selected VAE needs a32-pixel encoder grid, so the x2 target must be divisible by64; no silent rounding. Aspect-preserving preparation may center-crop.
Original AUDIO uses the SAME origin1s and its original sample rate, bypassing the Conform32k and LTX audio paths. AAC is not PCM-exact.
Explicit output backend: vhs_external. VHS preserves floating PCM input, including source AAC overshoot; it is NOT H3 Safe AV certification. No silent exporter fallback or normalization.
Source SHA/geometry is evidence, not a native H3 teacher latent or Cold cache. Both external effects default report_only.
Load policy is explicit; actual trained GPU, picture/voice review and general VFR/audio-PTS sync qualification are separate.

原采样次数、LoRA、底模、放大、音频和阶段接线保留。

旧 NOTE 中的 Relay 操作属于原版；本副本按上述普通入口编辑。
